commits.title: A product grid draws the tile island only when stock or Add to cart will show

changes.how: Add an exported pure function `tileAskFor(own: ShopTiles | undefined, store: ProductSettings): TileAsk | null` below tileShows(). It computes `const ask = tileAsk(own); if (!ask) return null; const shows = tileShows(ask, store); if (!shows.stock && !shows.quantity) return null; return { stock: shows.stock ? ask.stock : null, quantity: shows.quantity ? ask.quantity : null };`. It keeps the ask's own value ('show' or 'store') for a part that shows, so the island's later tileShows() with the route's fresh settings still decides (a switch turned off stops showing at once). Correct the file's header comment (lines 6 to 8): the store's two switches are read on the server with a cached read under their own tag and decide whether the island is drawn; the island still asks the route once a page for stock, which is never cached.

Add a describe 'tileAskFor' with four cases: (1) own undefined with DEFAULT_PRODUCT_SETTINGS gives null; (2) own { stock: 'show' } with defaults gives { stock: 'show', quantity: null }; (3) own undefined with { tileStock: true, tileQuantity: false } gives { stock: 'store', quantity: null }; (4) own { stock: 'hide', quantity: 'hide' } with both switches true gives null.

Add `export const productSettingsTag = (storeId: string) => `product-settings:${storeId}`;`. Add `export async function productSettingsCached(storeId: string): Promise<ProductSettings>` whose body starts with the directive 'use cache', then `cacheLife("hours")` and `cacheTag(productSettingsTag(storeId))` (import cacheLife and cacheTag from 'next/cache', written exactly as src/server/catalog.ts lines 285 to 287 write theirs), and returns `getProductSettings(storeId)`. In saveProductSettings(), after the insert statement and before the audit line, call `refreshTag(productSettingsTag(member.store.id))` (import refreshTag from './refresh'). Keep getProductSettings() uncached: the facts route and the admin's settings page keep reading it per request. Rewrite the doc comment above getProductSettings: the uncached read is for the facts route and the admin; productSettingsCached() is only for deciding whether a grid draws the island, under a tag of its own so a change does not refresh the catalogue.

Change the import from '@/lib/shop-tiles' to `import { tileAskFor, type TileAsk } from "@/lib/shop-tiles";` and import productSettingsCached from '@/server/product-settings'. At line 37 replace `const tiles = place.owner ? tileAsk(block.shopTiles) : null;` with `const tiles = place.owner ? tileAskFor(block.shopTiles, await productSettingsCached(place.owner)) : null;`. In RecommendingGrid (about line 139) replace `const tiles = tileAsk(block.shopTiles);` with `const tiles = tileAskFor(block.shopTiles, await productSettingsCached(owner));`. If the function holding line 37 is not async, stop and report (see stop_if). Update the two comments to say the store's settings are read on the server from the cached read.

Leave the first test ('a grid that shows them...') unchanged. Rewrite the second test ('a grid that follows the store shows nothing until...') as two tests. Test A, 'a grid that follows the store draws no island and asks nothing while the switches are off': storePageWith('tiles-off', [grid()]); record every request whose URL contains '/api/shop/tiles' before goto; goto; expect the tote tile visible; wait 1500 ms; expect 0 recorded requests and page.locator('[data-tile-shop]') count 0. Test B, 'a store whose settings show stock gives its tiles stock': storePageWith('tiles-store', [grid()]); insert the commerce.product_settings row (tile_stock true, tile_quantity false) with testDb() BEFORE the first page.goto, exactly the insert the old test used; then goto and expect the tote's [data-tile-stock] to have text 'På lager' and no 'Legg i handlekurven' button. Remove the old comment 'Read per request with the stock, so no cache is in the way'.

In the paragraph for D557 (find it: rg -n 'D557' docs/rules/admin/website.md; about line 726 to 728) replace the sentence that says the tile's island asks the route once a page, which answers the settings with the facts, by: 'The store's two switches are read on the server from a cached read under their own tag (`productSettingsCached()`, refreshed by `saveProductSettings()`), so a grid that would show neither draws no island and asks nothing; stock is never drawn on the server or cached: only a grid that shows it asks the route, once a page.'

changes.how: Add an exported `export const mineCookieName = (storeId: string) => `kaizen_mine_${storeId}`;` and an exported async function `markMine(storeId: string): Promise<void>` that sets that cookie on `await cookies()` with value '1', httpOnly false, secure `process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"`, sameSite 'lax', path '/', maxAge COOKIE_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60. In currentOwner(), make the first line of the function `if (create) await markMine(storeId);` (before getCustomer), so every save, signed in or not, leaves the marker. Never delete the marker anywhere: a stale marker only costs the old request.

In startSession(), at the end where `claimBrowserWishlists` is imported dynamically from './wishlists', also take `markMine` from the same dynamic import and call `await markMine(storeId);` before claimBrowserWishlists. A signed-in customer's saved products are then asked for on any device they sign in on.
